methods.semantics: Starts provider/domain-bound protocol transaction.

methods.name: CompleteSignin
methods.semantics: Invokes the selected adapter once, then atomically applies current JIT or repeat mapping, organization membership/role effects, vault linkage, and session issuance under one command; unknown emits no session and reconciles by command ID.

methods.name: VerifyDomain
methods.semantics: Calls the injected consumer-owned DomainProofEngine exactly once, translates the returned non-authoritative DomainProofObservation into organization.DomainEvidenceCommand, commits solely through organization.DomainEvidenceTransition, and recovers ambiguity without repeating the observation.

methods.semantics: Registers versioned validated provider.

methods.name: Route

methods.semantics: Atomically consumes login once.

methods.name: RecoverLogin
methods.semantics: Reads primary-authority command, identity, membership/role, vault, and session evidence; never resubmits protocol exchange or guesses rollback.

methods.name: ConsumeReplayID
methods.semantics: Atomically consumes one digest-indexed protocol replay identity under the SSO-owned transaction and retention policy; protocol adapters cannot select persistence.

methods.name: SaveMappingCheckpoint
methods.semantics: Persists the protocol-neutral provider/mapping/assertion checkpoint after validated protocol evidence without importing a protocol implementation.

methods.name: Put

methods.name: Get

zero_value_semantics: Every public ID, enum, request, result, policy, duration, URL, collection and secret wrapper rejects zero unless explicitly optional.
Optional values use named option types; empty strings, nil collections and zero timestamps never select defaults.
Every string is canonical UTF-8 with a type-specific finite bound; every collection has a declared finite cardinality; secret wrappers redact all formatting and serialization.

concurrency_ownership: Owns only the concrete observation engine; sso owns DomainProofRequest, DomainProofObservation, challenge issuance and orchestration, while organization owns authoritative proof.

zero_value_semantics: Every public ID, enum, request, result, policy, duration, URL, collection and secret wrapper rejects zero unless explicitly optional.
Optional values use named option types; empty strings, nil collections and zero timestamps never select defaults.
Every string is canonical UTF-8 with a type-specific finite bound; every collection has a declared finite cardinality; secret wrappers redact all formatting and serialization.

concurrency_ownership: Owns OIDC provider claims, representation, subject policy and logout validation; core owns private keys and session owns revocation.
Immutable values are safe for concurrent reads.
Constructed services are safe for concurrent calls; store rows, leases, command generations and capability reservations serialize mutation.

constructors.semantics: Validates all profiles, bounds, zero values, dependencies and ownership boundaries before returning a concurrency-safe service that implements both Service and oauthserver.OIDCExtension.
